api/code-review.title: Code Review Service API
api/code-review.description: The Code Review Service analyzes submitted code for correctness, style compliance, efficiency, and best practices.

api/code-runner.title: Code Runner Service API
api/code-runner.description: The Code Runner Service executes Python code in a sandboxed environment with strict resource limits.

api/concepts.title: Concepts Service API
api/concepts.description: The Concepts Service explains Python concepts, provides examples, and adapts explanations to student skill levels.

api/debug.title: Debug Service API
api/debug.description: The Debug Service analyzes error messages, identifies root causes, and provides hints before revealing full solutions.

api/exercise.title: Exercise Service API
api/exercise.description: The Exercise Service generates coding challenges, auto-grades submissions, and provides feedback.

api/progress.title: Progress Service API
api/progress.description: The Progress Service tracks student mastery across topics and provides detailed performance analytics.

api/triage.title: Triage Service API
api/triage.description: The Triage Service routes student questions to appropriate specialist agents based on query classification.

architecture/events.title: Event System
architecture/events.description: LearnFlow uses Kafka topics via Dapr pub/sub for asynchronous communication.

architecture/overview.title: Architecture Overview
architecture/overview.description: LearnFlow uses a microservices architecture running on Kubernetes with Dapr as the service mesh.

deployment/production.title: Production Deployment
deployment/production.description: Production uses ArgoCD for GitOps-based continuous delivery.

skills/overview.title: Skills Library
skills/overview.description: The Skills Library is a collection of 11 reusable Skills that work on both Claude Code and Goose.
